title: Encountering the Weight of His Glory
description: Get ready to experience a fresh outpouring of God's love and presence in your life as Pastor Chris Zehner leads an electrifying worship service at The River Church of Kansas City. In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris declares the weight of God's glory to fall and His presence to surround you, unleashing a fresh encounter with His love and power. Join in the joyful chaos of worship and prayer as Pastor Chris calls forth the anointing and transformation that only comes from the Holy Spirit.
